title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine with Italian Twist
description: A fusion of Italian and Tunisian flavors, this hearty lamb tagine is a delicious twist on traditional Italian braises.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb on all sides in batches, about 5 minutes per batch. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium and cook onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth, white wine, and honey (if using). Bring to a boil, scraping up browned bits.
Return lamb to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Braise lamb in the preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2-1/2 hours, or until tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
